moments.title: Commonwealth Games Glasgow 2026 underway
moments.blurb: The XXIII Commonwealth Games are currently ongoing in Glasgow, Scotland, running from July 23 to August 2, 2026, featuring 3,000 athletes from 74 nations competing across 10 sports.

angles.name: General excitement
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games are in full swing in Glasgow! Who are you cheering on this weekend as the action continues? #Glasgow2026

angles.name: Team England success
angles.copy: Team England swimmers have already bagged medals at #Glasgow2026! Huge congrats to Cam Brooker on silver in the 4x100 freestyle relay.

angles.name: Local Scottish pride
angles.copy: Glasgow is shining as host city for the Commonwealth Games! So much incredible sport on show, live from our doorstep. #Scotland

moments.title: Major UK Music Festivals this weekend
moments.blurb: Several big UK music festivals are happening this weekend and into next week, including Camp Bestival Dorset, Wilderness Festival, Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival, and Y-Not Festival.

angles.name: Festival vibes general
angles.copy: Who's living their best life at a festival this weekend? Camp Bestival, Wilderness, Belladrum, Y-Not... where are you heading? #FestivalSeason

angles.name: Camp Bestival highlights
angles.copy: Lulworth Castle is buzzing for Camp Bestival! Bastille, Fatboy Slim, Billy Ocean – what a line-up.

angles.name: Y-Not and Belladrum
angles.copy: Derbyshire has Y-Not with The Libertines, and Scotland has Belladrum with James and The Human League! So much great music on this week.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of July 23-29, 2026, marking its 18th non-consecutive week at the top.

angles.name: Chart topper celebration
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are dominating the Official Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. What a track!

angles.name: World Cup Anthem in Top 2
angles.copy: Shakira & Burna Boy's World Cup anthem 'Dai Dai' is still making waves, hitting #2 on the charts after that incredible halftime show!

moments.title: Verdine White turns 75
moments.blurb: Verdine White, legendary bassist and a founding member of Earth, Wind & Fire, celebrates his 75th birthday today, July 25, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday to a legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Verdine White of Earth, Wind & Fire! Still bringing the funk. What's your favourite EWF track? #VerdineWhite

angles.name: Musical influence
angles.copy: That iconic bassline! Verdine White, turning 75 today, has shaped so much of the music we love with Earth, Wind & Fire. A true icon.

moments.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
moments.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, will celebrate his 83rd birthday tomorrow, July 26, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mick
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the legendary Mick Jagger turns 83! Still got the moves like Jagger. What's your top Rolling Stones anthem?

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: 83 years young! Mick Jagger, the ultimate rock 'n' roll frontman, celebrates his birthday tomorrow. An absolute icon. #RockLegend

moments.title: Roger Taylor turns 77
moments.blurb: Roger Taylor, the acclaimed drummer for the legendary band Queen, celebrates his 77th birthday tomorrow, July 26, 2026.

source.l: Wikipedia / Off The Wall School Of Music

angles.name: Queen's drummer birthday
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to Queen's incredible drummer, Roger Taylor, who turns 77 tomorrow! What's your favourite Queen drum fill?

angles.name: Rock royalty
angles.copy: From 'Bohemian Rhapsody' to 'Radio Ga Ga', Roger Taylor's drumming is unmistakable. Happy 77th birthday to a rock legend tomorrow! #Drummer

moments.title: Missy Elliott turns 55
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper, singer, songwriter, and producer Missy Elliott will celebrate her 55th birthday on July 28, 2026.

angles.name: Iconic rapper's birthday
angles.copy: Get Ur Freak On! The one and only Missy Elliott turns 55 on Sunday. A true pioneer and legend. What's your favourite Missy track?

angles.name: Influence on music
angles.copy: Missy 'Misdemeanor' Elliott has continually pushed boundaries in music and video. Wishing her a very happy 55th birthday this weekend!

moments.title: Kate Bush turns 68
moments.blurb: Influential British singer-songwriter Kate Bush will celebrate her 68th birthday on July 30, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Kate
angles.copy: Wuthering Heights to Running Up That Hill! The visionary Kate Bush turns 68 on Thursday. Her music is timeless. #KateBush

angles.name: Music legend
angles.copy: A true artist who broke the mould. Happy 68th Birthday to the extraordinary Kate Bush later this week!

angles.name: Def Leppard frontman birthday
angles.copy: Pour Some Sugar On Him! Happy 67th Birthday to Def Leppard's legendary frontman, Joe Elliott, this Saturday! #DefLeppard

angles.name: Rock voice
angles.copy: That unmistakable voice! Joe Elliott turns 67 this weekend. What's your favourite Def Leppard power ballad?

moments.title: Chuck D (Public Enemy) turns 66
moments.blurb: Chuck D, the influential frontman of the hip-hop group Public Enemy, will celebrate his 66th birthday on August 1, 2026.

angles.name: Hip-hop pioneer birthday
angles.copy: Fight the Power! Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to the iconic Chuck D of Public Enemy this Saturday. #PublicEnemy

angles.name: Rap influence
angles.copy: A true lyrical force and game-changer in hip-hop. Chuck D turns 66 this weekend. What's his most impactful track for you?

moments.title: Adam Duritz (Counting Crows) turns 62
moments.blurb: Adam Duritz, the distinctive lead singer of the American rock band Counting Crows, will celebrate his 62nd birthday on August 1, 2026.

angles.name: Counting Crows frontman birthday
angles.copy: Mr. Jones and me... wish a very happy 62nd birthday to Adam Duritz of Counting Crows this Saturday! What's your favourite lyric from him?

angles.name: Iconic voice
angles.copy: The voice behind so many anthems, Adam Duritz turns 62 this weekend. A true songwriter.

moments.title: UK basks in summer heat, school holidays begin
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing a warm spell with temperatures in London potentially reaching 31°C by July 29, coinciding with the start of summer holidays for many schools across England and Wales.

angles.name: Heatwave update
angles.copy: The summer heat is on! Expecting some scorching temperatures across the UK this week, with London set to hit 31°C. Stay cool and hydrated!

angles.name: School's Out!
angles.copy: For many, the summer holidays are officially here! Whether you're stayingcationing or jetting off, enjoy the break. #SummerHolidays
